regions.merged_text: "What is religion anyway?" asked a little 8 year-old. "What is Religion re Echoed in the ears of several. "Ah!" came an Earnest answer, "Religion is not only a science; Its the science of all science. It is the science of our happy dependence (we being each our own first neighbor) on God and our neighbor."
